poc_summary: Trial window: 7 days of production-like traffic (mirror) + 2 weeks limited traffic on Hosted API
Observed during trial: avg daily requests ~10k, sustained QPS observed 6 QPS during business hours, peak burst to 22 QPS during product events
Avg tokens per request: 420 (prompt ~100 tokens, completion ~320 tokens)
Token mix observed: 60% short responses (<200 tokens), 30% medium (200-800 tokens), 10% long (>800 tokens)
Latency (Hosted trial): p50 ~220ms short, p95 ~650ms short; medium p95 ~1.8s; long p95 ~6.2s under trial limits
Cost sensitivity: trying to get under $0.003 per 1k tokens equivalent for steady workload; long tails are the biggest cost driver
traffic_forecast: Day-1 production target (post-POC): sustained 15 QPS average, typical concurrency 20–30, expected p95 latency SLO <= 800ms for 90% of requests
Growth plan (12 months): projected 3x traffic -> steady-state 45 QPS, peak planning for 65–80 QPS during campaigns
Monthly token estimate (year 1 steady): ~1.2B tokens/month based on usage mix and MAU projections
Peak concurrency planning: assume 50 concurrent streams with average KV cache hit rate ~30%
Expected tail: ~10% of requests will need long completions (>800 tokens) and will drive GPU memory planning
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Initial Dedicated pool suggestion: 2 H100-equivalent nodes for baseline throughput (handles sustained 15 QPS + caching/batching)
Autoscale plan: allow burst +2 nodes during peak to reach effective peak capacity (65–80 QPS); target 4 nodes for headroom
Model/quantization: start with int8/qat variant of selected open model; enable KV prefix caching to reduce recomputation for chat-like flows
Batching config: conservative latency-first batch size to meet p95 <= 800ms; enable continuous batching with 20ms max gather window for short requests
Expected unit economics: with Dedicated and quantization, estimated token cost reduction 20–30% vs Hosted list pricing; need final runbook to confirm
